queried_goods_code.description: The TARIC-acceptable goods code that was queried (typically 10 digits; some headings only accept CN8)

queried_origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 origin/destination code used as TARIC Area parameter

queried_destination_country.description: Informational only — TARIC does not differentiate destination beyond Area

reference_date.description: ISO date used for the TARIC consultation (default: today)

taric_last_update.description: From the page metadata 'Last TARIC update' (DD-MM-YYYY)

taric_status.description: confirmed = code+origin returned measures; not_found = TARIC has no measures (or code does not exist); blocked = couldn't complete the lookup

mfn_rate_text.description: Third-country (MFN) duty text exactly as TARIC displays it (e.g., '3.00 %' or '50 EUR / 100 kg net')

mfn_rate_bps.description: Parsed ad valorem rate in basis points when mfn_rate_text is a simple percent; null when compound/specific

supplementary_unit.description: Supplementary unit description (e.g., 'm²', 'pa', 'p/st', 'kg net'); null when TARIC does not declare a supp unit at this code

has_cbam.description: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism — present on iron/steel/aluminium/cement/fertiliser/electricity/hydrogen codes

measures.description: Extracted measure rows; each item has measure_type and rate_text and (where present) geographical_area, conditions, footnotes

source_url.description: Direct deep-link to the TARIC consultation result
